name: Right to information about the requesting party
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to acquire Information on the full identity, the legal grounds, the purpose of the request and the use of Personal Data, and the accountability of the party requesting the Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to complete, update and/or rectify
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to complete, update, and/or rectify errors and/or inaccuracy of Personal Data concerning him/her according to the purpose for which the Personal Data is processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right of access and to obtain a copy
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to have access to and obtain a copy of Personal Data concerning him/her in accordance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to end processing, erase and/or destroy
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to end the processing, erase, and/or destroy Personal Data concerning him/her in accordance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to withdraw consent
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to withdraw the consent to the processing of Personal Data concerning him/her that has been given to the Personal Data Controller.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to object to automated decision-making
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to file an objection to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which has a legal impact concerning him/her or has a significant impact on the Personal Data Subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to postpone or restrict processing
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to postpone or restrict the processing of Personal Data in proportion to the purpose for which the Personal Data is processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to claim and recover damages
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to claim for and recover damages for a breach of the processing of Personal Data concerning him/her in accordance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to acquire and/or use Personal Data in a portable format
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to acquire and/or use Personal Data concerning him/her from a Personal Data Controller in a structured, commonly used and/or electronic system-readable format.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

name: Right to use and transmit Personal Data to another Controller
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to use and transmit Personal Data concerning him/her to another Personal Data Controller, to the extent the system used can mutually exchange communications securely within the principle of Personal Data protection under this Law.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf
